quote.text: It is wrong always, everywhere, and for anyone, to believe anything upon insufficient evidence.
quote.author: W. K. Clifford, “The Ethics of Belief”, Contemporary Review, 1877

stories.kicker: The World · The Gulf Tanker War
stories.headline: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard says its forces struck seven ships in the Gulf
stories.dek: US Central Command says no vessel has hit a mine and 95 per cent of traffic is still getting through. The IRGC named no ship, no flag and no operator.

stories.headline: NEA records Singapore’s first clean air board since 5 October
stories.dek: The agency’s own forecast puts the haze back over the island on Friday. Twelve years into the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act, no company has been fined under it once.

stories.headline: Ten million Thais hold a death benefit priced in the surviving headcount
stories.dek: A funeral mutual pays fifty baht times everyone still alive. Deaths have exceeded births for five years, and in Udon Thani a three-contract payout has fallen from 200,000 baht to 58,000.

stories.headline: Roger + Chris says the twine behind eight-way hand-tying is no longer made
stories.dek: The Hickory maker, which owns its own frame plant, calls drop-in spring units “fake cheese”. Hancock & Moore’s own glossary says most top-grain leather has had its grain sanded off.

stories.headline: Homeland Security orders DeepSeek stripped from every federal civilian system
stories.dek: The notice reached the Federal Register on 20 October as 91 FR 66346. The signed order inside it survives only as scanned images, so its deadlines cannot be read.

stories.headline: INMO puts the GO3 display glasses on general sale at US$509
stories.dek: The maker’s own page publishes no brightness, no field of view and no weight. The 1,500-nit figure every write-up quotes comes from a sponsored post.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · H. Moser & Cie.
stories.headline: H. Moser prices its Saquon Barkley tourbillon identically to the standard reference
stories.dek: Reference 3811-1205 lists at CHF 79,000 before Swiss VAT, in 97 pieces. So does the standard 3811-1200, on the maker’s own site.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · You Can See Everything
stories.headline: A24 expands its Elizabeth Holmes documentary to more than 2,500 screens
stories.dek: It opened on 855 screens and took $18,247 from each, against Street Fighter’s $8,608 from 3,575. Its Rotten Tomatoes score has fallen from 100 to 97 as the sample tripled.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Phones After Ten
stories.headline: JAMA Pediatrics measures the ten o’clock line with sensors, not surveys
stories.dek: Each extra minute of phone use after 10pm cost 0.43 minutes of sleep across 7,591 nights. Singapore’s MOE moved its locked bedtime to 10.30pm in January.

stories.headline: Meta’s cash outflow knocked 17 basis points off the US ten-year on Thursday
stories.dek: The 10-year fell to 4.96 per cent, its sharpest one-day drop since March 2023, while Brent rose 3.72 per cent to $112.87 and gold fell 2.82 per cent.

stories.headline: Ultralight backpacking judges a kit list on Lighterpack, to the gram
stories.dek: A base weight under ten pounds is the entry ticket, and the initiation is publishing your gear list to the gram for a million strangers to pick apart.

stories.headline: Penn State trial puts four minutes a day against a waitlist control
stories.dek: Ninety-seven adults averaging 74 years old gained 4.22 chair stands in twelve weeks. The control group lost 28 per cent of its participants; the intervention group lost 11.

stories.headline: Gardens by the Bay takes the world premiere of The Story of Studio Ghibli
stories.dek: Tickets run S$39 for a Singapore-resident adult, S$29 for a child, from 18 December to 4 July. ART SG’s early-bird two-for-$40 closes on 24 November.
